title: The Sweet Bird Confectionery Factory
victim: Gedeon Romashkin, founder of the factory
teaser: On the night shift the factory smells of vanilla, so nobody noticed the bitter smell from the glazing room. In the morning the founder was found next to a cold cauldron. The recipe for the new praline vanished with him, so now they're looking for a thief as well as a killer.

habits.label: Caramel burn
habits.habit: A fresh caramel burn on the palm
clues: On the rim of a cauldron in the glazing room there's a hardened drop of caramel with a scrap of skin in it. The culprit has a burn on their palm.
A bandage has been opened and the burn ointment is missing from the first-aid kit at the gatehouse. The culprit has a fresh burn on their palm.

habits.label: Smells of cinnamon
clues: The glazing room smells of nothing but vanilla all night, yet there's a smell of cinnamon by the cauldron. The culprit's clothes smell of cinnamon.
The chair in the founder's office smells of cinnamon, and the factory hasn't used cinnamon since spring. The culprit smells of cinnamon.

habits.label: Rocket badge
habits.habit: A rocket badge on the lapel
clues: A little rocket badge glints in the set glaze by the cauldron. The culprit wears a rocket badge.
The shift foreman remembers an enamel rocket on a lapel by the door of the flavour lab. The culprit wears a rocket badge.

habits.label: Pocket radio
habits.habit: A pocket transistor radio with an earpiece
clues: An earpiece on a wire from a pocket radio was left on a shelf in the packing room. The culprit carries a transistor radio.
At around four the gatehouse watchman heard quiet music from the glazing room, as if from someone's pocket. The culprit carries a pocket radio.

habits.label: Green food dye
habits.habit: Fingers stained with green food dye
clues: The handle of the founder's office door has a green smear of the pistachio colouring used for glaze. The culprit's fingers are stained with green dye.
The empty recipe folder in the flavour lab has green fingerprints on it. The culprit's fingers are stained with green dye.

habits.label: Freckles
clues: In the lamplight the gatehouse watchman saw a face covered all over in freckles. The culprit has freckles.
In his mirror the driver at the loading bay made out a face ginger with freckles. The culprit has lots of freckles.

habits.label: Plays guitar
clues: A plectrum and a broken guitar string lie on a crate in the packing room. The culprit plays guitar.
At around three in the morning the watchman heard someone picking at a guitar over by the loading bay. The culprit plays guitar.

habits.label: Plaid shirt
clues: A scrap of red-and-blue checked cloth hangs on a nail by the loading bay. The culprit wears a plaid shirt.
The packer saw the collar of a checked shirt under a white coat by the cauldron. The culprit wears a plaid shirt.

habits.label: Chipped tooth
clues: A bitten bar of chocolate in the founder's office shows a tooth mark with a gap in it. The culprit has a chipped front tooth.
The shift foreman remembers a smile with a chipped tooth by the cauldron. The culprit has a chipped front tooth.

habits.label: Does crosswords
clues: A newspaper was left at the gatehouse with its crossword finished in blue pen down to the last square. The culprit does crosswords.
The margin of a draft recipe in the founder's office has words filled into little squares, across and down. The culprit does crosswords.

habits.label: Keeps bees
clues: There's a dead bee and some crumbs of wax in the raw-materials store, and the factory hasn't had honey delivered since autumn. The culprit keeps bees.
The step of the lorry at the loading bay has a sticky smear of honey and a bit of honeycomb on it. The culprit keeps bees.

habits.label: Swallow tattoo
habits.habit: A swallow tattooed on the wrist
clues: The gatehouse watchman saw a blue swallow peep out from under a sleeve. The culprit has a swallow tattoo.
There's a handprint in the set glaze by the cauldron, and the outline of a bird shows at the edge of the wrist. The culprit has a swallow tattooed on their wrist.

habits.label: Cracks knuckles
clues: From behind the shelves in the raw-materials store the packer heard the dry crack of knuckles, again and again. The culprit cracks their knuckles.
In the dark the gatehouse watchman recognised a familiar cracking of knuckles but didn't see the face. The culprit cracks their knuckles.

habits.label: Rabbit's foot
habits.habit: A rabbit's foot on a key ring
clues: A fluffy rabbit's foot on a broken chain lies by the cauldron in the glazing room. The culprit carries a rabbit's foot.
A tuft of white rabbit fur with a key-ring loop lies on the loading bay floor. The culprit carries a rabbit's-foot key ring.

habits.label: Afraid of cats
clues: The factory cat, which roams the workshops all night, was found shut in the packing room. The culprit is afraid of cats.
A stool is knocked over by the cat's bowl at the gatehouse, as if someone had jumped away from the cat. The culprit is afraid of cats.

habits.label: Turquoise ring
habits.habit: A turquoise ring on one finger
clues: A small blue turquoise stone that fell out of its setting was found at the bottom of a vat in the glazing room. The culprit wears a turquoise ring.
The door of the founder's office has a fresh scratch at hand height and a blue crumb of stone. The culprit wears a turquoise ring.

tools: The valve on the cauldron in the glazing room was shut and its handwheel taken off, the nuts laid out beside it. The culprit is handy with tools.
A desk drawer in the founder's office was prised open with a chisel right along the seam. The culprit is handy with tools.
candy: A mint sweet wrapper lies by the cold cauldron, and the factory doesn't make mints. The culprit carries sweets.
There's a sticky wrapper from someone else's toffee on the table in the flavour lab. The culprit carries sweets.
keys: The founder's office is locked, the lock is intact, and the recipe is gone. The culprit had keys.
The raw-materials store was opened at night with its own key, though keys are handed in at the gatehouse for the night. The culprit had keys.
sched: Someone went into the glazing room in the quarter of an hour when the night shift takes its break. The culprit knows the schedule.
The cauldron was switched off exactly between two of the watchman's rounds. The culprit knows the schedule.
strong: The founder was dragged from his office to the cauldron, forty steps across slippery tiles. The culprit is physically strong.
In the raw-materials store a fifty-kilo sack of cocoa beans was shifted to cover a hatch. The culprit is physically strong.
tech: The extractor in the glazing room was turned off, and the fuse box in the corridor bridged with wire. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
The conveyor in the packing room was stopped from inside the motor, not with the button. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
safe: The safe in the founder's office was opened without force, and the praline recipe is gone. The culprit knows the safe combination.
The small sample safe in the flavour lab was opened on the first try. The culprit knows the safe combination.
cash: Half the night shift's wages are missing from the envelope at the gatehouse, and the payroll has been signed. The culprit had access to money.
The money for new equipment has vanished from a drawer in the founder's office, though the books say it was paid out properly. The culprit had access to money.
driver: The van from the loading bay went somewhere overnight: there are twelve extra kilometres on the clock. The culprit can drive.
There are fresh tyre tracks through spilled sugar by the loading bay gates. The culprit can drive.
passages: From the glazing room the footprints go through the ventilation corridor to the raw-materials store, bypassing the gatehouse. The culprit knows the service passages.
A door behind the shelves in the packing room opens straight onto the loading bay, and the dust on it has been wiped off. The culprit knows the service passages.
medic: The bitter smell in the glazing room came from a tincture slipped into the founder's cocoa. The culprit knows about poisons.
A bottle of bitter almond extract is missing from the flavour lab, and exactly one mouthful was measured out. The culprit knows about poisons.
quiet: The packer was working on the other side of the wall and heard neither footsteps on the iron floor nor a creak of the door. The culprit moves silently.
The gatehouse watchman sleeps so lightly he hears the cat, yet that night he didn't wake once. The culprit moves silently.
french: A draft recipe in the flavour lab has a note: "praliné, trop amer". The culprit knows French.
A French confectioner's handbook lies open at the praline chapter in the founder's office. The culprit knows French.
